decisions.reason: A Google Analytics 4 plugin fits the post-Universal-Analytics market in 2024 and is likely to remain commercially relevant for clients.
A Google Universal Analytics plugin is largely obsolete in 2024 after Google's migration to GA4, so keeping it on the market would make little strategic sense.
A retail system interface plugin can still support client integration needs, although its niche nature makes it somewhat more vulnerable than a core analytics product.
Shop relaunch SEO support is a service-oriented offering with continuing demand and its own page suggests the firm sees it as a meaningful part of its portfolio.
